name: sdk-public-api-change
description: Assess, make and document changes that affect the public API or the contract with angular-sdk and override consumers (exports, inputs, selectors, $-suffixed properties, base classes) - breaking-change classification, API report workflow, deprecation protocol and migration notes.

# Public API and consumer contract

## Who depends on what

- `@pega/angular-sdk-components`: everything exported from `packages/angular-sdk-components/src/public-api.ts`; consumed by `pegasystems/angular-sdk`.
- `@pega/angular-sdk-overrides`: generated copies of components that customers edit and register in their local component map; they subclass `FieldBase`/template bases and read `$`-suffixed properties.
- `<component-mapper>` call sites: `name` + `props` keys form the contract between templates and components.

## The report

`etc/angular-sdk-components.api.md` is generated by api-extractor from the built library. CI fails when it differs from the build.

```bash
npm run build-angular-sdk-components
npx api-extractor run                  # fails on any difference
npx api-extractor run --local                 # accepts the new API; review `git diff etc/`
```

## Classify the change

| Change                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Class                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| new export, new optional input, new method, new component                                                                                                                                                                     | additive (minor)                                                            |
| widening a type, adding an optional param                                                                                                                                                                                     | additive                                                                    |
| rename/remove/retype an export, input, output, selector, `$` property or method; change visibility; change a base class's behaviour or constructor; change `component-mapper` props contract; make an optional thing required | **breaking (major)**                                                        |
| change of change-detection strategy of a component customers subclass                                                                                                                                                         | potentially breaking (stale UI) - treat as breaking unless proven otherwise |
| internal refactor, no signature change                                                                                                                                                                                        | none                                                                        |

## Making a breaking change (only when requested/approved)

1. Prefer a non-breaking path: add new API, keep the old one, mark old with `/** @deprecated use X (removal in <version>) */`, keep both working.
2. If it must break (it also belongs under the "Breaking changes" heading of the release in `CHANGELOG.md`, see `sdk-changelog`): conventional commit with `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer (helps reviewers; the release version is chosen manually at release time); add a migration note to `docs/adr/` (decision, reason, before/after code) and to the PR description.
3. Update overrides impact: run `npm run build-overrides && npx ngc -p tsconfig.overrides-check.json`; an override copy that no longer compiles is a breaking signal.
4. Update docs that show the API (`docs/customizing.md`, `docs/components.md` via `node scripts/generate-component-catalog.js`).

## Review checklist

- [ ] every `api.md` diff line is intentional and explained in the PR
- [ ] additive changes are optional/have defaults
- [ ] `FieldBase`/`FormTemplateBase`/`DetailsTemplateBase` behaviour unchanged for existing subclasses (generic default stays `any`)
- [ ] selector unchanged (`app-...`), mapper key unchanged
- [ ] `package.json` peerDependencies of `packages/angular-sdk-components` still correct (see `sdk-upgrade-dependencies`)
- [ ] commit message conveys the class of change
